name: Spectra Wood Showroom
old_description: As we enter into our 45th year, we remain confident that building quality solid wood furniture of great value, good design, and practical use will endure the test of time. We hope that our website will be a valuable source of information and inspiration when purchasing Home or Contract Furnishings.
about:
Spectra Wood Showroom operates from State College, Pennsylvania, where it has produced solid wood furniture for 45 years. The company traces its roots to a commitment to value-driven design and practical construction, though a specific founding year and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The product line spans bedroom, dining, office, and occasional collections—including the Asher, Bristol, Carlisle, and Franklin series—covering beds, bookcases, desks, dining tables, dressers, and entertainment units. Construction follows a standard wood-to-wood glued joint reinforced with screws, applied to solid wood tops, drawer fronts, rails, and all exposed components. The facility functions as a factory showroom, though square footage and headcount are not published.

Spectra serves both residential and commercial channels. Home furnishings are sold through a retailer network, while contract sales target hospitality, education, and workplace projects. The company emphasizes American-made production for both markets.

The company states that its furniture is built to endure through quality materials, good design, and practical use, positioning American manufacturing as a core differentiator.
